import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.width',250)
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d = df[df.account_id=='sBGaYvw']
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
piv = d.pivot_table(index=key, columns='date', values='unblended_cost')
cols = sorted(piv.columns)
# baseline stats per row
base = piv[[c for c in cols if c<'2025-10-20' and c>='2025-09-20']]
mean = base.mean(axis=1); std = base.std(axis=1)
cur = piv['2025-10-20']
z = (cur-mean)/std.replace(0,1e-9)
out = pd.DataFrame({'mean':mean,'std':std,'cur':cur,'z':z}).join(piv.reset_index().set_index(key)['2025-10-19'].rename('prev'))
print(out.sort_values('z',ascending=False).head(15))

{"code": "import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.width',250)
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d = df[df.account_id=='sBGaYvw']
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
piv = d.pivot_table(index=key, columns='date', values='unblended_cost')
cols = sorted(piv.columns)
# baseline stats per row
base = piv[[c for c in cols if c<'2025-10-20' and c>='2025-09-20']]
mean = base.mean(axis=1); std = base.std(axis=1)
cur = piv['2025-10-20']
z = (cur-mean)/std.replace(0,1e-9)
out = pd.DataFrame({'mean':mean,'std':std,'cur':cur,'z':z}).join(piv.reset_index().set_index(key)['2025-10-19'].rename('prev'))
print(out.sort_values('z',ascending=False).head(15))"}

{"code": "import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.max_columns',None); pd.set_option('display.width',300)
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d = df[df.account_id=='sBGaYvw']
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
piv = d.pivot_table(index=key, columns='date', values='unblended_cost')
cols = sorted(piv.columns)
base = piv[[c for c in cols if c<'2025-10-20' and c>='2025-09-20']]
mean = base.mean(axis=1); std = base.std(axis=1)
cur = piv['2025-10-20']
z = (cur-mean)/std.replace(0,1e-9)
out = pd.DataFrame({'mean':mean.round(2),'std':std.round(2),'prev':piv['2025-10-19'].round(2),'cur':cur.round(2),'delta':(cur-piv['2025-10-19']).round(2),'z':z.round(2)})
print(out.sort_values('z',ascending=False).head(6).to_string())
# time series of top resource
top = out.z.idxmax()
print(d[(d.csp==top[0])&(d.cloud_service==top[1])&(d.application==top[2])&(d.instance_family==top[3])][['date','price','num_instances','unblended_cost']].tail(15).to_string())"}
